description: This is a C source file that implements parsing and processing of telemetry profile configurations, including JSON and MessagePack formats. It includes functions for extracting parameters, handling trigger conditions, encoding configuration, and setting protocol-specific details for telemetry profiles like HTTP and RBUS. The code manages profile data structures, memory, validation, and integration with external modules.
